$comment: The words of the demo video, in both interface languages, read by tour.spec.ts.

Each scene has a caption (step, title, body: two lines on the caption card, read on screen) and a narration (the same thing written for the ear: abbreviations spelled out, full sentences). The narration is spoken when the video is rendered with a voice; the subtitles carry the caption.

{records}, {sources}, {total}, {relevant}, {extracted} and {values} are filled at recording time with the scenario's own figures (FACT_NAMES in tour.spec.ts), so a caption stays true when the corpus grows. A scene whose figure is unknown is skipped.

order: the scenes of the default video, filmed on a real deployment (scripts/demo_video.py --base-url). The local demo on its synthetic corpus films the same order and skips what its corpus does not have (no extraction, no AI text); it takes its question, its assistant question and its title card from the synthetic block.

doubleBlind is recorded only on request (DEMO_SCENES=doubleBlind): the kappa interpretation it shows is served in French whatever the interface language (api/double_blind.py). Put it back in order once that label is translated.
Never the em dash (CLAUDE.md); tests/test_demo_video.py checks that both languages caption and narrate the same scenes with the same figures.

takeawayCard.title: What leaves the application

groups.title: Articles
items: Relevant articles or the whole corpus
Excel, CSV, RIS, BibTeX, JSON, Markdown

ask.title: Ask
ask.body: Write the question in plain words or as a Boolean query. With live sources ticked, one search queries eleven databases, PubMed and OpenAlex among them.
ask.narration: Write the research question in plain words, or as a Boolean query. With live sources ticked, one search queries eleven databases, PubMed and OpenAlex among them.

scenarios.title: Every search becomes a scenario
scenarios.body: Its records are deduplicated across sources and saved: {total} here, ready to be screened, synthesised and kept up to date.
scenarios.narration: Every search becomes a scenario: {total} records here, deduplicated across sources, ready to be screened, synthesised and kept up to date.

corpus.title: Score and select
corpus.body: Each record gets a semantic score and a Cohere rerank against the question. The threshold picks those that feed the analyses: {relevant} here. The rest are kept.
corpus.narration: Each record gets a semantic score and a Cohere rerank against the question. The threshold picks those that feed the analyses: {relevant} here. The rest are kept.

sources.title: The relevant articles, ranked
sources.body: The relevant articles, ranked, beside each database's share and the years of publication. They export in six formats, from Excel and CSV to RIS and BibTeX.
sources.narration: The relevant articles are ranked, next to each database's share and the years of publication. They export in six formats, from Excel and CSV to RIS and BibTeX.

article.title: Read and decide
article.body: Open an article to read its abstract and its PICO, then include or exclude it with a reason. Each decision is counted in the PRISMA flow.
article.narration: Open an article to read its abstract and its PICO, then include or exclude it, with a reason. Each decision is counted in the PRISMA flow.

prisma.title: Screen the PRISMA way
prisma.body: The PRISMA 2020 flow counts each step: {records} records from {sources} databases, duplicates removed, AI pre-screening, human decisions and the evidence set.
prisma.narration: The PRISMA 2020 flow counts each step: {records} records from {sources} databases, the duplicates removed, the AI pre-screening, the human decisions and the evidence set.

prismaSources.title: Database by database
prismaSources.body: Each database shows its count, the total it announced and whether a cap cut it. When one cannot take the whole Boolean query, the card gives the query it received.
prismaSources.narration: Database by database: the count, the total announced and whether a cap cut it. When a database cannot take the whole Boolean query, the card gives the query it received.

strategy.title: The search strategy, kept
strategy.body: The Strategy tab keeps the query as it was sent: the Boolean strategy, its PubMed version with MeSH terms and its explanation, ready for a methods section.
strategy.narration: The Strategy tab keeps the query as it was sent: the Boolean strategy, its PubMed version with MeSH terms and its explanation, ready for a methods section.

doubleBlind.title: Screen in double blind
doubleBlind.body: Two reviewers can screen independently of each other. The app computes Cohen's kappa and lists the conflicts to arbitrate.
doubleBlind.narration: Two reviewers can screen independently of each other. The app computes Cohen's kappa and lists the conflicts to arbitrate.

evidence.title: Synthesise the whole corpus
evidence.body: Study designs, sources and levels of evidence are counted over all {relevant} relevant articles, in the database, never on a sample.
evidence.narration: Study designs, sources and levels of evidence are counted over all {relevant} relevant articles, in the database itself, never on a sample.

epiParams.title: Epidemiological parameters
epiParams.body: Parameters such as R0, case fatality and incubation are pooled over every article that reports one, weighted by quality, with their interval and number of studies.
epiParams.narration: Parameters such as R naught, case fatality and incubation are pooled over every article that reports one, weighted by quality, with their interval and number of studies.

brief.title: An evidence brief, as a draft
brief.body: The AI drafts a brief over the whole corpus, with a level of evidence and a GRADE rating, for a reviewer to check. It exports as a PDF or a citable report.
brief.narration: The AI drafts an evidence brief over the whole corpus, with a level of evidence and a GRADE rating, for a reviewer to check. It exports as a PDF or a citable report.

claims.title: Claims, actions and gaps
claims.body: Each claim cites its articles; its strength comes from their designs, not from the model. Actions and research gaps follow, beside a gap matrix computed without AI.
claims.narration: Each claim cites its articles, and its strength comes from their study designs, not from the model. Actions and research gaps follow, beside a gap matrix computed without AI.

pico.title: One extraction per article
pico.body: Population, intervention, comparator and outcome are extracted once per article, then read across the whole corpus, never over a sample.
pico.narration: Population, intervention, comparator and outcome are extracted once per article, then read across the whole corpus, never over a sample.

extraction.title: Structured extraction
extraction.body: The Extraction tab fills the review's template from every relevant article, in full text when it is open: {extracted} articles, {values} values, each with its quote.
extraction.narration: The Extraction tab fills the review's template from every relevant article, in full text when it is open: {extracted} articles and {values} values, each with its exact quote.

coverage.title: What the papers report
coverage.body: These cards give the share of extracted articles that report each topic: sex, age, occupation, protective equipment, vaccination, animal hosts. A click lists them.
coverage.narration: These cards show the share of extracted articles that report each topic, such as sex, age, occupation or protective equipment. One click lists those articles.

sheets.title: Five sheets and a codebook
sheets.body: The values fill the template's five sheets, from human susceptibility to animals and vectors. Their labels follow a codebook a reviewer can edit.
sheets.narration: The values fill the five sheets of the template, from human susceptibility to animals and vectors. Their labels follow a codebook that a reviewer can edit.

quotes.title: Every value has its quote
quotes.body: Open an article: each row gives a value, its cases and group size, and the exact sentence behind it, shown in the paper. A reviewer accepts, edits or rejects it.
quotes.narration: Open an article. Each row gives a value, its cases and group size, and the exact sentence behind it, shown in the paper. A reviewer accepts, edits or rejects each row.

downloads.title: Take the extraction away
downloads.body: The extraction downloads as the review's Excel template, a flat CSV or a report in PDF or Word, and the reviewed rows as an annotated dataset.
downloads.narration: The extraction downloads as the review's Excel template, a flat CSV, or a report in PDF or Word, and the reviewed rows as an annotated dataset.

geography.title: Where the evidence comes from
geography.body: Each study's place resolves to a country and, when it is known, to a European NUTS region. Places that do not resolve are listed, never guessed.
geography.narration: Each study's place resolves to a country and, when it is known, to a European NUTS region. Places that do not resolve are listed, never guessed.

pooled.title: Pooled estimates and comparisons
pooled.body: Pooled estimates combine the counts the studies report, label by label, in a random-effects model with a forest plot. Comparisons give odds ratios between groups.
pooled.narration: Pooled estimates combine the counts the studies report, label by label, in a random-effects model with a forest plot. Comparisons give odds ratios between groups.

assistant.title: Ask the corpus
assistant.body: The AI Assistant answers from the relevant articles only, with counts taken from the whole corpus. Each answer cites its sources and is kept with its date.
assistant.narration: The AI Assistant answers from the relevant articles only, with counts taken from the whole corpus. Each answer cites its sources and is kept with its date.

assistantAnswer.title: A cited answer, kept
assistantAnswer.body: A kept answer shows its question, date and scope, its citations and articles, and exports to PDF, Word or Markdown. Asked again, it shows what changed.
assistantAnswer.narration: A kept answer shows its question, date and scope, its citations and articles, and exports to PDF, Word or Markdown. Asked again, it shows what changed.

clusters.title: Explore the literature
clusters.body: Topic clusters show what the corpus is made of. Each gets an AI summary, its key words and its most representative article, and its articles export.
clusters.narration: Topic clusters show what the corpus is made of. Each one gets an AI summary, its key words and its most representative article, and its articles can be exported.

concepts.title: Map concepts and gaps
concepts.body: The concept map links pathogens, hosts, exposures, outcomes and places. Click one to see its links and articles. Pairs never studied together are gaps.
concepts.narration: The concept map links pathogens, hosts, exposures, outcomes and places. Click a concept to see its links and its articles. Pairs never studied together are gaps.

variables.title: From evidence to a model
variables.body: The variables the literature points to become a model specification: an outcome, predictors with their sources and an algorithm. Plug in real data, and train.
variables.narration: The variables the literature points to become a model specification: an outcome, predictors with their sources and an algorithm. Plug in real data, and train.

model.title: Train, explain, monitor
model.body: The trained model reports its accuracy, its drivers and its guardrails, and raises an alert when a prediction crosses its threshold.
model.narration: The trained model reports its accuracy, its drivers and its guardrails, and raises an alert when a prediction crosses its threshold.

alerts.title: Keep it living
alerts.body: Subscribe to alerts. The living review queries PubMed on a schedule and adds the new articles to the scenario.
alerts.narration: Subscribe to alerts. The living review queries PubMed on a schedule and adds the new articles to the scenario.

takeaway.title: Everything you can take away
takeaway.body: Everything leaves the app: articles in six formats, the extraction workbook and its report, pooled estimates, the annotated dataset, clusters and concepts.
takeaway.narration: Everything leaves the application: articles in six formats, the extraction workbook and its report, pooled estimates, the annotated dataset, clusters and concepts.

strategy.narration: L'onglet Stratégie garde la requête telle qu'elle a été envoyée : la stratégie booléenne, sa version PubMed avec les termes MeSH et son explication, pour une section Méthodes.

evidence.narration: Devis d'étude, sources et niveaux de preuve sont comptés sur les {relevant} articles pertinents, dans la base elle-même, jamais sur un échantillon.

epiParams.narration: Des paramètres comme le R zéro, la létalité ou l'incubation sont mis en commun sur tous les articles qui en rapportent, pondérés par la qualité, avec intervalle et nombre d'études.

brief.narration: L'intelligence artificielle rédige une synthèse de tout le corpus, avec un niveau de preuve et une note GRADE, qu'un relecteur vérifie. Elle s'exporte en PDF ou en rapport citable.

claims.title: Affirmations, actions et lacunes

claims.narration: Chaque affirmation cite ses articles, et sa force vient des devis des études, pas du modèle. Suivent les actions et les lacunes, à côté d'une matrice calculée sans intelligence artificielle.

pico.title: Une extraction par article
pico.body: Population, intervention, comparateur et critère sont extraits une fois par article, puis lus sur tout le corpus, jamais sur un échantillon.
pico.narration: Population, intervention, comparateur et critère sont extraits une fois par article, puis lus sur tout le corpus, jamais sur un échantillon.

extraction.title: Extraction structurée

extraction.narration: L'onglet Extraction remplit le modèle de la revue à partir de chaque article pertinent, en texte intégral quand il est ouvert : {extracted} articles et {values} valeurs, chacune citée.

coverage.narration: Ces cartes montrent la part des articles extraits qui rapportent chaque thème, comme le sexe, l'âge, la profession ou les équipements de protection. Un clic liste ces articles.

sheets.title: Cinq feuilles et un codebook
sheets.body: Les valeurs remplissent les cinq feuilles du modèle, de la sensibilité humaine aux animaux et aux vecteurs. Leurs libellés suivent un codebook modifiable.
sheets.narration: Les valeurs remplissent les cinq feuilles du modèle, de la sensibilité humaine aux animaux et aux vecteurs. Leurs libellés suivent un codebook qu'un relecteur peut modifier.

quotes.title: Chaque valeur a sa citation

quotes.narration: Ouvrez un article. Chaque ligne donne une valeur, ses cas, son effectif et la phrase exacte d'où elle vient, montrée dans l'article. Un relecteur accepte, corrige ou rejette chaque ligne.

downloads.body: L'extraction se télécharge dans le modèle Excel de la revue, en CSV ou en rapport PDF ou Word, et les lignes revues en jeu de données annoté.
downloads.narration: L'extraction se télécharge dans le modèle Excel de la revue, en fichier CSV, ou en rapport PDF ou Word, et les lignes revues en jeu de données annoté.

geography.body: Le lieu de chaque étude est rattaché à un pays et, quand il est connu, à une région européenne NUTS. Les lieux non rattachés sont listés, jamais devinés.
geography.narration: Le lieu de chaque étude est rattaché à un pays et, quand il est connu, à une région européenne NUTS. Les lieux non rattachés sont listés, jamais devinés.

pooled.narration: Les estimations poolées combinent les comptes des études, libellé par libellé, dans un modèle à effets aléatoires avec un forest plot. Les comparaisons donnent des odds ratios entre groupes.

assistant.title: Interroger le corpus

assistant.narration: L'assistant répond à partir des seuls articles pertinents, avec des comptes pris sur tout le corpus. Chaque réponse cite ses sources, et elle est gardée avec sa date.

assistantAnswer.title: Une réponse citée, conservée

assistantAnswer.narration: Une réponse conservée montre sa question, sa date, sa portée, ses citations et ses articles, et s'exporte en PDF, Word ou Markdown. Reposée, elle montre ce qui a changé.

concepts.narration: La carte relie pathogènes, hôtes, expositions, critères et lieux. Un clic sur un concept montre ses liens et ses articles. Les paires jamais étudiées ensemble sont des lacunes.

model.narration: Le modèle entraîné indique sa précision, ses facteurs et ses garde-fous, et déclenche une alerte quand une prédiction franchit son seuil.

alerts.narration: Abonnez-vous aux alertes. La revue vivante interroge PubMed à intervalle régulier et ajoute les nouveaux articles au scénario.
